recipe.title: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti until al dente.
While pasta cooks, cut guanciale into small strips and cook in a dry pan over medium heat until crispy.
In a bowl, whisk together egg yolks and grated Pecorino Romano.
Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of pasta water.
Toss hot pasta with guanciale, then remove from heat.
Add egg and cheese mixture, tossing quickly to create a creamy sauce. Add pasta water as needed.
Season generously with black pepper and serve immediately.

contents.text: Here's a Classic Spaghetti Carbonara recipe — an intermediate Italian dish with guanciale, egg yolks, and Pecorino Romano. It takes about 30 minutes total to prepare and cook.
